root: ^General Alcino: Back from the library, are you? Judging by that expression, I’d say the shelves put up quite the fight.
^An orc was already there. He knocked me out... I’m afraid he escaped.

c-0: ^General Alcino: An orc scout, here? Charming. And you—knocked out cold. Hah! Hours ago you were ready to storm an entire warband, and one scout has already carved his signature across your skull.
^General Alcino: Still… your bruises aren’t the problem. What matters is what he might have discovered while you were busy napping on the floorboards.
^ No doubt this forces my hand—we’ll need spies of our own to uncover the orcs’ next moves.
^General Alcino: Travel to the West Bridge. Captain Pleias commands the garrison there—when he isn’t drowning in ale. Tell him, “Hoist the tankards.” He’ll know you carry my word.
^General Alcino: Don’t fret, recruit. You’ve done well enough. But remember this: the elves are poets, not soldiers.
^ The moment the orcs believe the Cold Fire Stone is within Arun Village, they’ll strike—swift, merciless, and without warning.
